bundle.shortDescription: Secure WireGuard client with a real kill switch
bundle.longDescription: Alizy is a WireGuard desktop client with an OS-level nftables kill switch, IPv4/IPv6 controls, DNS leak protection and split tunnelling. The privileged service alizyd is packaged separately.
